gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Verifies that remove() succeeds after next() when the iterator is backed by a mutable ListIterator that supports removal.
ADDED i3: Build a single-element list containing Boolean.FALSE via IdentityPredicate evaluation
ADDED i4: Evaluating the identity predicate against null returns false (null != referenceObject)
ADDED i5: remove() should delegate to the backing ListIterator without throwing
ADDED i6: Verifies that findNextByIterator() can be called with a sibling ObjectGraphIterator that has a null transformer, without throwing.
ADDED i7: Verifies that remove() throws IllegalStateException when the inner iterator (an ObjectGraphIterator) did not have next() called on it directly, so its lastUsedI
ADDED i8: ConstantTransformer always returns the same value (rootValue) regardless of input
ADDED i9: outerIterator treats innerIterator as its root iterator
ADDED i12: Verifies that next() throws NoSuchElementException when the underlying iterator is empty and there are no elements to return.
ADDED i15: Verifies that findNextByIterator() on a sibling ObjectGraphIterator with the same root and transformer does not mutate the original iterator reference.
ADDED i16: Verifies that calling findNext() on the inner iterator before wrapping it in an outer iterator still allows the outer iterator's next() to return the correct va
ADDED i17: Manually prime the inner iterator's "next found" state
ADDED i18: Verifies that findNextByIterator() with a null-rooted iterator (one constructed with a null root) does not throw an exception.
ADDED i19: nullRootedIterator has no elements since its root is null
ADDED i20: Verifies that findNext() called with an Iterator argument causes the iterator to recurse into that argument via findNextByIterator().
ADDED i21: constantTransformer always returns null; used as both test input and graph transformer
ADDED i22: Evaluating notNullPredicate on a non-null transformer returns true
ADDED i23: Passing an Iterator to findNext() should trigger traversal of that iterator
ADDED i24: Verifies that constructing an ObjectGraphIterator whose root is another ObjectGraphIterator with a null transformer does not throw.
ADDED i25: outerIterator wraps innerIterator as its root, also with a null transformer
